charts.question: Post-initialization work
charts.supported_finding: All algorithms answer the same station/time queries to every reachable destination.
charts.interpretation_boundary: The archive assigns each download a non-overlapping archive interval. This is a comparison of overlapping planned calendar service inside those files. Results concern scheduled travel in a selected network, with a stated same-station transfer buffer and no street-walking links.
